originalMetadata.title: This is why you still don’t know your purpose
originalMetadata.description:
you’ve been told you’re lazy but maybe you’re just exhausted from chasing stuff that never really mattered maybe it’s not your work ethic that’s broken maybe it’s your direction no one thrives chasing goals that don’t feel like home the truth is you don’t need more hustle you need more alignment find your purpose or waste your energy proving you're not lazy to people who don’t even know you
